slides.title: HIPFIRE WORKS
rules: MW4 has no hipfire bloom: shots go where your weapon points.
In close fights you can skip aiming down sights.

slides.title: SHOOT THE SMOKE
rules: Gunfire and explosions break up Smoke Grenade + Smoke Wall cover.
The gaps open short sightlines through the smoke.

slides.title: TRIP WIRE TRAPS
rules: Several Trip Wires link into one network of explosives.
Set them where enemies will walk, not where they stand.

slides.title: SPAM YOUR UTILITY
rules: Every Field Upgrade recharges: use it more than once per match.
Lethal. Since Nov 16: 75% less impact damage at range. Use it close.

slides.title: LITHIUM DOORS
rules: Press the button next to a garage door to partly close it.
Slide under it to surprise players on the other side.

slides.title: KILL BLOCK GUNFIGHT
rules: Use the letter + number grid on the outer walls.
In Gunfight, layout + shared loadout change every 2 rounds.
Gunfight round timed out? Grab the Overtime Flag.

MW4 tips and tricks 🔥 6 Modern Warfare 4 tricks most players miss in multiplayer: hipfire with no bloom, shooting holes in Smoke Grenade cover, chaining Trip Wires into one trap, recharging Field Upgrades like the Trophy System, the Lithium garage door slide and Kill Block callouts in Gunfight. Which trick did you not know? Comment 1–6 👇 Save this for your next match & send it to your squad!
